fields.label: Web Crawl Description
fields.readOnlyReason: Descriptive constant. Not a runtime setting.
fields.help: Description string for the web crawl source type.

fields.label: Git Crawl Description
fields.readOnlyReason: Descriptive constant. Not a runtime setting.
fields.help: Description string for the git crawl source type.

fields.label: Max Crawl Depth
fields.help: How many levels deep to follow links from the starting URL. A depth of 1 fetches only the seed page; 2 also follows links found on that page, etc.

fields.label: Max URLs
fields.help: Hard cap on the total number of pages the crawler will fetch in a single run.

fields.label: Min Content Length
fields.help: Minimum character count for a page's extracted text. Pages below this threshold are skipped.

fields.label: Min Content Lines
fields.help: Minimum number of text lines (crawl4AI counts from 0). Pages with fewer lines are skipped.

fields.label: Include External Domain
fields.help: When enabled, the crawler follows links to domains other than the seed URL's domain.

fields.label: Language
fields.help: ISO 639-1 language code. Pages not matching this language are skipped.

fields.label: URL Pattern Filters
fields.readOnlyReason: Python list expression. Edit the config file directly.
fields.help: A Python list of URL substring patterns. Only URLs containing at least one pattern are crawled.

fields.label: Use URL List
fields.help: When enabled, the crawler reads a predefined URL list instead of performing deep crawling from a seed.

fields.label: URL List File
fields.help: Filename (relative to the data directory) containing one URL per line to crawl.

fields.label: Custom Regex
fields.help: Enable custom regex-based post-processing on the crawled markdown output.

fields.label: Add Lines to Code Blocks
fields.help: Copies the line immediately preceding a code fence into the block as a code comment for added context.

fields.label: Ignore Links
fields.help: Strip hyperlinks from the generated markdown, keeping only the link text.

fields.label: Ignore Images
fields.help: Remove image references from the generated markdown.

fields.label: Escape HTML
fields.help: HTML-encode special characters in the markdown output.

fields.label: Body Width
fields.help: Maximum line width for the markdown generator. 0 means no wrapping.

fields.label: Skip Internal Links
fields.help: Remove same-page anchor links (e.g. #section) from the markdown.

fields.label: Include Sup/Sub
fields.help: Preserve <sup> and <sub> HTML tags in the markdown output.

fields.label: Heading Style
fields.help: Markdown heading format. ATX uses hash marks (# Heading); SETEXT uses underlines.

fields.label: List Style
fields.help: Character used for unordered list items in the generated markdown.

fields.label: Strip Comments
fields.help: Remove HTML comments from the output.

fields.label: Preserve Tables
fields.help: Keep HTML tables in the markdown output rather than converting or stripping them.

fields.label: Collapse Whitespace
fields.help: Merge consecutive blank lines and spaces into single spaces.

fields.label: Strip Footnotes
fields.help: Remove footnote references and definitions from the markdown.

fields.label: Strip Code Blocks
fields.help: Remove fenced code blocks entirely from the markdown output.

fields.label: Strip Blockquotes
fields.help: Remove blockquote markup from the markdown output.

fields.label: Strip Math
fields.help: Remove LaTeX/math blocks from the markdown output.

fields.label: Markdown Generator
fields.help: Name of the markdown generator module used by CrawlerRunConfig.

fields.label: Cache Mode
fields.readOnlyReason: Python enum expression (CacheMode.BYPASS). Edit the config file directly.
fields.help: CrawlerRunConfig cache strategy. Controls whether pages are served from cache or re-fetched.

fields.label: Excluded Tags
fields.readOnlyReason: Python list expression. Edit the config file directly.
fields.help: HTML tags to strip before conversion. The crawler removes these elements and their children.

fields.label: Remove Forms
fields.help: Strip <form> elements from the page before markdown conversion.

fields.label: Remove Overlay Elements
fields.help: Attempt to detect and remove modals, popups, and overlay elements.

fields.label: CSS Selector
fields.help: CSS selector that limits extraction to a specific page region (e.g. '.main'). Leave empty to extract the full page.

fields.label: Excluded Selector
fields.help: Comma-separated CSS selectors for elements to remove before extraction (e.g. '.sidebar, #toc').

fields.label: Exclude External Links
fields.help: Remove links pointing to external domains from the final markdown content.

fields.label: Exclude Social Media Links
fields.help: Remove links to known social media sites from the markdown.

fields.label: Exclude Domains
fields.readOnlyReason: Python list expression. Edit the config file directly.
fields.help: Python list of domain names whose links are stripped from the output.

fields.label: Exclude Social Media Domains
fields.readOnlyReason: Python list expression. Edit the config file directly.
fields.help: Python list extending the default social media domain blocklist.
